name: City Center
summary: Mixed-use shopping complex combining apartments, an arts center, and popular chain stores and eateries in a walkable downtown White Plains location. This lifestyle destination offers convenient access to retail, dining, and cultural experiences with a strong community focus.
demographics: City Center attracts a diverse, affluent demographic from White Plains and surrounding Westchester County communities, with a strong representation of young professionals, families, and urban residents living in the mixed-use development's apartments. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes significantly above the national average, typical of the Westchester market. Visitors include both local residents seeking convenient shopping and dining options within walking distance, as well as regional shoppers drawn to the popular chain retailers and arts programming, creating a vibrant mix of daily-needs and destination shopping patterns.
description: City Center in White Plains stands as Westchester County's premier mixed-use destination, seamlessly blending retail, dining, residential living, and cultural experiences into one dynamic urban environment. This innovative lifestyle center has transformed downtown White Plains into a walkable, vibrant community hub where residents of the on-site apartments can step out their doors to access popular chain stores and eateries alongside an active arts center. The open-air design creates an inviting streetscape atmosphere that encourages exploration and community gathering, distinguishing it from traditional enclosed mall formats. With operating hours from 8 AM to 10 PM daily, City Center accommodates both early morning coffee runs and evening entertainment, serving as a true live-work-play destination. The center's strong 4.4-star rating from over 3,400 reviews reflects its success in creating a compelling retail and lifestyle experience that resonates with both residents and visitors throughout the greater White Plains area.
